Summary: The publication year for "Attention Is All You Need" by Vaswani et al. is 2017. This research paper, published in the 31st Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NIPS) and also available on arXiv, introduced the transformer architecture, which relies entirely on attention mechanisms to achieve sequence-to-sequence tasks. The paper was authored by eight scientists and engineers working at Google and has since become foundational in the field of machine learning and natural language processing.

Hinton for their foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks. Their work, which began in the 1980s, laid the groundwork for modern machine learning and deep learning technologies. The prize was announced on October 8, 2024, by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
